summary: Validated the COLD 1 cold-storage refactor end-to-end. Updated backend_test.py to reflect SCHEMA_VERSION=2 (640 bins, 4 zones with 3 placeholders, 25 frozen PLT SKUs, 39 drive-in lanes split A=13/B=11/C=15 with type-specific depth/levels/weight). All 23 backend tests pass. Frontend Storage page renders 4 zone cards (COLD-1 active 55%/350-of-640, 3 placeholders showing 'Awaiting blueprint' / 'ZONE NOT CONFIGURED'), 39 lane cards with 4-level horizontal strips, Row/Type filter chips work (Row A→13, Type B→11), lane drawer opens with rack details (Type/Levels/Depth/Slots/Weight/Occupied) and pallet contents (LIFO order showing real SKU codes & names). Dashboard shows 25 SKUs, 640 bins active, $113,970 stock value, 54.7% utilization. AI insights endpoint returns Claude-generated cold-chain commentary. Inbound (PO create + receive) and Outbound (advance pending→picking→packing→shipped) flows work with new pallet locations.
critical_code_review_comments: Performance: Storage.jsx LaneDrawer fetches /inventory/skus/{id}/stock in a loop for every SKU (25 sequential calls) every time a lane drawer opens. Recommend a single endpoint like /storage/lanes/{row}/{lane}/contents that returns stock-by-bin in one call. Currently usable but adds ~1-3s lag.
Dead code: Storage.jsx LaneDrawer lines 358-366 — Promise.all fetches /storage/locations?zone=COLD-1 for each occupied bin and discards the result; should be removed.

Semantics: The drawer header says '// PALLET CONTENTS // LIFO ORDER' but the list is actually sorted by (level, position) — there's no time-based ordering. Either rename the label or sort by inbound timestamp to truly reflect LIFO drive-in retrieval order.

API shape: /api/inbound/{id}/receive returns {ok: true} (no order body); /api/outbound/{id}/advance returns {ok, status}. Inconsistent shape — consider returning the updated order in both for symmetry.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, storage zones, 39 lanes, placeholder empty state, Row/Type filters, lane drawer, dashboard, inventory)

Bin code pattern: COLD1-{row}-L{lane}-LV{level}-P{pos}. Placeholder zones COLD-2/COLD-3/AMBIENT exist in zones_meta with bins=0 and placeholder=true. LaneDrawer fetches stock via per-SKU loop — slow but works.
